channel.title: Macetes GTA 6 (English)
channel.description: GTA 6 cheats, easter eggs, secrets and money tips for PS5 and Xbox, checked against gameplay videos before going live.

item.title: GTA 6 on PC: What We Know About the Cyberleek Xbox Leak and Why You Can't Play It Yet
item.description: Cyberleek released the Xbox build's executable and fans are racing to run GTA 6 on PC. So far it only reaches a black screen or the menus. Here's what's real, what's fake and the official way to play on PC.

item.title: Can You Play GTA 6 on PC, PS4, Xbox One or Game Pass?
item.description: GTA 6 is only on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. There is no PC or PS4 version, Xbox One can only stream it from the cloud, and it isn't part of Game Pass.

item.title: GTA 6 Bulldozer Cheat (HVY Bulldozer)
item.description: The GTA 6 bulldozer cheat (hvy bulldozer) is Left, Up, Right, Down, Left, Right, Right, Down. Spawns an HVY Bulldozer. Unlock it when you find the HVY Bulldozer in the world so it is logged in the Progress menu.

item.title: How to Make GTA 6 Easier: Difficulty, Accessible Combat and Vehicle Damage Settings
item.description: GTA 6 has easy mode options in the Gameplay settings: Accessible Combat cuts the damage you take, Reduced Vehicle Damage protects your car and Simplified Mini Games removes the timing.

item.title: GTA 6 Hidden Features the Game Doesn't Explain
item.description: GTA 6 lets you flip your car back over by pushing it, sit anywhere, turn on autopilot, keep outfits in the trunk to shake the cops and skip a taxi ride for about $100. Here are the controls.

item.title: GTA 6 No Reload Cheat
item.description: The GTA 6 no reload cheat is Down, Up, Right, Down, Left, Left, Up, Down, Down, Up. Ammo never runs out and you never need to reload. Unlock it when you win 25 gold medals at shooting ranges.

item.title: GTA 6 Raise Wanted Level Cheat
item.description: The GTA 6 raise wanted level cheat is Left, Down, Right, Down, Up, Right, Up. Raises your wanted level (police stars). Unlock it when you lose a 3-star wanted level 50 times.

item.title: GTA 6 Vehicle Force Cheat
item.description: The GTA 6 vehicle force cheat is Down, Up, Left, Left, Right, Down, Left, Up, Down. Vehicle collisions launch targets. Unlock it when you kill 25 enemies (or pedestrians) with a vehicle.

item.title: How to Sell Cars in GTA 6 (Moses, Randy and Car Registration)
item.description: Sell stolen cars at a Pay 'n' Spray (3 a day), to Moses or to Randy. Here's what they pay, how to register a car you want to keep, and how to get one out of the impound.

item.title: GTA 6 Wyman's Classic Car Collection: All 15 Part Locations, Cost and the Free Jacket
item.description: With the Special or Ultimate Edition, Wyman builds 5 classic cars from 15 parts you scan around the map. Here's how to unlock it, where the parts are, what it costs and what you get at the end.

item.title: GTA 6 Moses Drop-Off Locations: All 7 Cars and the Secret Sultan Reward
item.description: In Chapter 2, Moses asks for 7 cars that never show on the map. Here's where each one is, how to sell to him without wasting money and the fully customized car he gives you at the end.

item.title: Is Paul Walker's Car in GTA 6? Where to Find the Fast & Furious Eclipse
item.description: Yes: GTA 6 has a nod to Paul Walker's green Eclipse from The Fast and the Furious, in a garage on Vespucci Island in the Rialto Islands. Wait until you unlock Moses so you can register and keep it.

item.title: GTA 6 Free Tank Forever: The Secret Bunker Mission and Door Codes
item.description: A hidden quest that starts at a Vice City memorial leads to two bunkers. You walk away with the legendary Russo's 1922 pistol, a rifle and a tank that always respawns. Codes 010317 and 085355.

item.title: GTA 6 Legendary and Unique Weapons: All the Locations Found So Far
item.description: GTA 6 legendary and unique weapon locations by region: suppressed M306, gold KZ59, Assassin Nipper .38, Smuggler Gorse 425, Dirty Drifter, snipers and more.

item.title: GTA 6 Brooks Boatworks Safe Code: 6823 (Port Gellhorn)
item.description: The Brooks Boatworks safe code in GTA 6 is 6823. See where the wall map with the codes hangs, where the safe is and where to pick up the Clunker 556 rifle.

item.title: GTA 6 Chapter 3 Laptop Password: Muffins, Queen, 15 (Free Garage and Pink Growler)
item.description: The Chapter 3 laptop password in GTA 6 is Muffins, Queen, 15. See where the clues are, what the 92665 code opens in La Perle and how to claim Vanessa's pink Growler.

item.title: GTA 6 La Cascara Motel Safe Code: 6969 (Port Gellhorn)
item.description: The La Cascara Motel safe code in GTA 6 is 6969. See where the code is written, how to reach the safe at the top of the motel and where to grab the Scrapper VF5C SMG.

item.title: GTA 6 Safe Codes: How to Find the Combination and Open Safes in Robberies
item.description: Every GTA 6 safe has its own code, and some are fixed: bowling alley 0300, La Cascara Motel 6969 and Brooks Boatworks 6823. Find the rest with Focus mode or by threatening an employee.

item.title: GTA 6 Easter Eggs: Every Secret Found So Far
item.description: Every GTA 6 easter egg found so far: the Vice City portal, the Mario block, Bigfoot (the Skunk Ape), the radio tower egg, the jet ski dog, the alien lab, Dexter and more.

item.title: GTA 6 Rare Car Locations: Every Car on Randy's Wish List
item.description: Where to find the 10 rare cars on Randy's wish list in GTA 6: Banshee, Tempesta, Infernus, Vacca, Gauntlet Hellfire, Mamba GT, Paragon, Furia, Toros and Growler, with times and how to steal each.

item.title: GTA 6 Vice City Portal Easter Egg: How to Visit 2002 Vice City
item.description: GTA 6 hides a portal that sends Jason to the PS2-era Malibu Club. Here's the tower, the 12 substations and which switch to hit, the power plant hours and the rewards.

item.title: GTA 6 Satan Boss Fight Easter Egg: How to Start the Ritual, Beat Satan and Get the Shotgun
item.description: At a yellow house in Port Gellhorn after midnight, two metalheads invite you to a ritual that turns into a Doom-style trip through hell. Beat Satan for a unique red shotgun and a permanent health boost.

item.title: GTA 6 Mario Easter Egg: Where to Find the Block With Jason and Lucia's Hats
item.description: The GTA 6 Mario easter egg is a hidden block in the brick ruins southwest of Moreau, Lummox County. Break it for two caps: a J for Jason and an L for Lucia.

item.title: GTA 6 Autosave Explained: When the Game Saves and How to Avoid Losing Progress
item.description: GTA 6 only autosaves after story missions and bigger side missions. Small errands and free roam aren't saved on their own, so save manually from the Game menu before you switch off.

item.title: GTA 6 Error CE-108255-1 on PS5: What It Is and What to Try
item.description: Error CE-108255-1 crashes GTA 6 on PS5, usually after early story cutscenes. The November 23 patch fixes several crashes but doesn't name this code, so there's no official fix yet.

item.title: GTA 6 Crashing or Stuck on Loading Screen: How to Fix
item.description: If GTA 6 crashes, freezes or won't load, check PlayStation or Xbox server status and restart the game first. On PS5, restore your licenses; on Xbox, fully power cycle the console.

item.title: All GTA 6 Fence Locations: Where to Sell Stolen Goods
item.description: GTA 6 has 5 fences for drugs, jewelry and marked bills, plus 2 car buyers. Each fence pays best for a different item, and some only pay after you leave.

item.title: How to Lose the Police in GTA 6: Heat, Search Zones and Disguises
item.description: To lose the cops in GTA 6, get out of the search zone and stop matching your description: respray your car at Pay 'n' Spray, change outfits or get a haircut. Watch out for stolen car trackers.

item.title: GTA 6 Patch Notes: What the First Update Fixes (November 23)
item.description: GTA 6's first post-launch patch landed on November 23 with seven fixes: crashes, autosave, stuck weather, missing phone calls, wanted levels, the gym deadlift and fence bags.

item.title: 2 GTA 6 Loot Spots With a Legendary Rifle, Big Cash and a Free Supercar
item.description: Two GTA 6 robbery spots with a legendary assault rifle: a gated house just north of Little Cuba with $25k in stash bags and a nitrous Mercedes, and a Vespucci Island mansion with a free Emerus.

item.title: GTA 6 Black Eagle Import M306 Location (Free Suppressed Rifle)
item.description: The Black Eagle Import M306 TMR is hidden in the warehouse beside the Black Eagle gun store, near Griffin Shooting Range. Here are both ways into the room.

item.title: GTA 6 Bowling Alley Safe Code: 0300 (Kingpin Bowling)
item.description: The Kingpin Bowling safe code in GTA 6 is 0300. See where it's written down, how to blow the safe open and which unique shotgun to take from the pool table.

item.title: GTA 6 Map: All 5 Counties and What's in Each One
item.description: The GTA 6 map is split into 5 counties: Vice-Dale, Leonard, Kelly, Lummox and Mariana. Here are the main spots in each, from Vice City and the airport to the military base and Key Lento.

item.title: GTA 6 Mask, Clothing, Tattoo and Barber Shop Locations
item.description: GTA 6 clothing stores, tattoo parlors and salons are listed under the Style tab of the map index, and they never close. For a mask, the confirmed option is a bandana from Ammu-Nation.

item.title: GTA 6 Radio Stations and Songs: Every Station, Host and Track Revealed So Far
item.description: Flash FM and V-Rock alone hold 150 songs in GTA 6, and Weird Al hosts Vice City FM. Here are the stations, the hosts named in the credits and the songs on each station.

item.title: How Many Copies Has GTA 6 Sold? 32.5 Million Before Launch
item.description: Official figures: GTA 6 sold 32.5 million copies before release and made $3.79 billion in day one retail sales, according to Take-Two.

item.title: GTA 6 Assassin Nipper .38 and Smuggler Gorse 425 Locations
item.description: Both legendary guns sit in shipwrecks on the small islands near Mile Zero Air Station in Mariana County. You can grab them early without a fight.

item.title: GTA 6 UFO House Easter Egg: Where the San Andreas House Is and How to Get In
item.description: The UFO house Rockstar teased in the San Andreas remaster is in GTA 6, in Bellville, Leonard County. The front door is fake, but you can break in through the garage.

item.title: GTA 6 Collectible Cards: Locations and How Much They Sell For
item.description: GTA 6 collectible cards hide in safes and stashes and sell at pawn shops. The one in the early warehouse fetches $6,000 in Hamlet. Here are the confirmed locations and whether you should sell.

item.title: GTA 6: Where to Find Your First Plane and Helicopter (Near Jason's House)
item.description: In GTA 6, seaplanes and a helicopter sit unguarded in Southwind, about 2.5 miles from Jason's house in Key Lento. You can take them without getting a wanted level.

item.title: GTA 6 Bigfoot (Skunk Ape) Mission: How to Start It and Get the Camo Sniper Rifle
item.description: GTA 6's Bigfoot is the start of a hidden side quest. After you black out at the effigy in Grassrivers, find a note, call the number and hunt the Skunk Ape at night. The reward is a unique camo sniper rifle.

item.title: GTA 6 Bank Account and ATMs: How to Deposit and Protect Your Cash
item.description: Your GTA 6 bank account unlocks in the Chapter 1 mission Buck Me, and then any ATM takes deposits. Until then, hide your cash under the bedroom floorboards in Key Lento.

item.title: GTA 6 Parrot Money: How to Rob the "Strange Noises" Liquor Store
item.description: The Three Sheets liquor store hides over $2,000 in its Exotic Animals Front ("Strange Noises") operation: a safe, the register and a stash only the parrot gives away, in the vent by the generator.

item.title: GTA 6 Strangers and Freaks: Side Missions Found So Far
item.description: The GTA 6 Strangers & Freaks trophy asks for 8 stranger mission strands. There's no official list yet. Here's what players have found on day one: Shirley, Kirk, Kenton and street encounters.

item.title: How to Make Money Fast in GTA 6: Best Early and Late Game Methods
item.description: The fastest ways to make money in GTA 6: Kenton's shipwreck dives (up to $4,000), Dog Island, Donnie's packages, robbing other criminals, selling stolen cars and the Ambrosia demolition derby.

item.title: GTA 6 Beginner Tips: 15 Things to Know Before You Start
item.description: The best GTA 6 tips for beginners: settings worth changing, stashing your cash, the $5,000 BuckMe goal, your phone as a quest log, cops that remember you and more.

item.title: GTA 6 Sunken Treasure: How to Dive Kenton's Shipwrecks and Make Money
item.description: In GTA 6, dive captain Kenton opens up the shipwrecks with the mission Island Dreams. Dive with the metal detector, collect the treasure and sell it back to him: one dive can pay up to $4,000.

item.title: How to Get Every GTA 6 Ultimate Edition and Pre-Order Bonus
item.description: GTA 6's Ultimate Edition and pre-order bonuses unlock bit by bit from Chapter 1 to Chapter 5. Here's where to find each car, weapon, shop and outfit, and which ones are Chapter 1 only.

item.title: GTA 6 Parachute Location: Where to Buy One, Free Spots and How to Use It
item.description: In GTA 6 you buy a parachute once at an Ammu-Nation that sells clothes. Free ones wait at all 25 base jump spots, on the Key Lento radio tower, on some skyscraper roofs and on Mount Kalaga.

item.title: How to Use Auto Drive in GTA 6 (Cars and Boats)
item.description: In GTA 6, set a destination, hold down on the D-pad while driving and switch to the cinematic camera. Enable Auto Drive then shows up and the car or boat drives itself there.
